title: Record the bit-0 budget gap
body:
## Summary
- For class sizes `10+d` and `10-d`, the within-class pair count is `90+d^2`, so the even collision budget is `27+d^2`.
- The cross-pair count is `100-d^2`. It drops below the 64 odd masks for `d = 7, 8, 9, 10`, so those splits cannot be universal.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged, and this check does not decide `f(7)`.
